title: Bulk actions on pages and posts lists

entries.summary: POST /admin/pages|posts/bulk with ids[] and bulk_action. Publish/draft/delete (pages) plus pin/unpin (posts). Homepage skipped for draft/delete. Max 100 ids. Checkboxes associated via form= so row action forms stay separate.
No schema change. Soft-delete and status/sticky live in existing cms_pages/cms_posts columns.
